title: Firearm Volume 1 #10 July 1994 Ultraverse Malibu Comics - James Robinson
descriptionText: The product is a Firearm Volume 1 #10 comic book from July 1994 by Malibu Comics, written by James Robinson. This issue features the character Ship and is signed by James Robinson. It is a color comic book in single issue format, part of the Modern Age era of US Comics. This collectible item is graded as 9.0 Very Fine/Near Mint and would be a valuable addition to any comic book enthusiast's collection.
